Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 4
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the WebSurfer’s findings for Esma Sultan Mansion, which clearly indicated it is in the Ortaköy neighborhood (Beşiktaş), and instead incorrectly stated it was in the Laleli neighborhood (Fatih). This led to the wrong conclusion that both landmarks are in the same neighborhood.
